# Vendored cortex — provenance

- typesafe.mjs / moth.mjs / glm.mjs / receipts.mjs: copied from SuperInstance/quilt-cortex (cortex/)
- arena_moth.mjs: the moth-quantum vault client, copied from SuperInstance/quilt-arena (arena/moth.mjs)
- moth.mjs was repointed at ./arena_moth.mjs so the loom is self-contained.
- Keys are read from the environment (TYPESAFE_API_KEY / MOTH_API_KEY) — never hardcoded.

The Divergent Logic Foundry — a GAN that breeds logic as different as possible, yet still correct.

A generator breeds new implementations of the same game logic. A discriminator forges adversarial probes to catch fakes — and scores every survivor by how different it is from everything ever crowned. The equilibrium: an archive of maximally-divergent, proven-correct logic — durable understanding, woven in quilt sheets.

01 — the adversarial loom

Classic GANs train a forger against a judge. Here the forger writes logic and the judge owns probes. The discriminator's arithmetic — compile, probe, score — runs inside quilt program cells; listeners crown, scar, and harden as reflexes. The tension is real: every fake the generator slips through makes the forge harder; every scar the forge takes narrows the generator's escape routes.

GENERATOR — the breeder

  • mech voice — strategy families × form dials × corruption pressure (0 tokens)
  • render walks — breeds 4 variants, keeps the one structurally farthest from its lineage
  • System One voice — one batched typesafe call per generation: axis + alien-score + hunger
  • System Two wildcard — on deep plateau, GLM writes a whole alien bloodline

DISCRIMINATOR — the forge

  • probe vector — hand-forged + random + boundary + rare-answer mining
  • scar tissue — every probe that killed a candidate is kept forever
  • novelty metric — 0.65·behavioral + 0.35·structural (α-normalized 3-grams)
  • hardening reflex — fake pressure > 0.5 → budget ×1.25, the sheet ratchets itself

02 — replay the offline run

· 5 game-derived contracts × 24 generations × 8 candidates, fully deterministic, zero live calls. Scrub the generations — watch the sheet's cells move, the forge harden, the crowns land.

03 — the archive wall

Every card is a different correct implementation of the same contract — bred, probed, and crowned by the loom. Same behavior, alien bloodlines. This is the durable product: drop any specimen into a quilt program cell and it just works.

04 — the live leg · the chord spine

The same loom, wired to the real tri-provider cortex: typesafe.ai System One directing each generation in one batched call, MOTH quantum entropy salting the forge, GLM System Two writing wildcard bloodlines on plateau. Budgeted, receipted, replayed from cache for free.

The moment that proves the loom: on a novelty plateau, System Two was handed the Hearts contract and told to be structurally alien. Its first wildcard passed every probe with novelty 0.861 — crowned alien, a brand-new bloodline. Its second wildcard failed 37% of probes — the forge caught the fake. Both verdicts receipted in the witness chain.
